parsed.internal_thinking:
I have just placed my second settlement on node 41 (Ore 5, Wheat 9, Brick 10). I need to place a road from node 41. Looking at the tool results from `analyze_path_potential`: 
1. Path to 42: Leads toward node 50 (3:1 port) and node 43 (where I already have a settlement). While node 50 is a great goal for my wheat production, placing a road toward 42 is redundant for expansion since node 43 is already occupied by me and node 42 itself is not buildable (too close to 41/43).
2. Path to 40: Leads toward a Wood port (W2) and node 39. I don't have strong Wood production yet, so this is less interesting.
3. Path to 31: Leads toward the center. Node 31 has Wheat 9, Brick 10, and Wood 11 (9 pips). More importantly, it opens up a path toward node 30 or 32. 

However, my primary goal with this heavy Wheat/Ore setup is to secure a port. Node 50 (3:1) is the most logical step to convert my surplus. But wait, node 42 is between 41 and 43. I already have a road from 43 to 42. If I place a road from 41 to 42, they connect. This is good for Longest Road but doesn't immediately help expansion. 
Actually, the best expansion spot is node 31 or node 50. Since I already have a road at 42, placing my new road from 41 to 40 or 41 to 31 makes more sense to branch out. Node 31 offers a mix of resources (Wheat, Brick, Wood) which I need. Node 40 is a dead end unless I want the Wood port. I'll go towards 31 to keep my options open for the center and more varied resources.
parsed.note_to_self: Placed starting road from 41 to 31. This heads toward node 31 (Wheat 9, Brick 10, Wood 11) and provides a path into the center or toward node 30.
